The instant criminal misc. petition under Section 528 BNSS has been filed on behalf of the petitioners praying that a direction be issued to the respondents to conduct fair, proper, impartial and expeditious investigation in case arising out of FIR No.512/2024 registered at Police Station Udaimandir, District Jodhpur City East for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC.

He seeks fair, impartial and expeditious investigation in this matter.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent No.2 submits that a counter FIR has also been lodged by the petitioner, which also requires fair, impartial and expeditious investigation.
4. Seeking fair impartial and expeditious investigation is a fundamental right of a person, be he a complainant/victim or the accused.

5. It is, therefore, directed that the petitioners and the respondent No.2 shall submit their separate representation to the concerned Superintendent of Police in connection with their respective FIRs along with all documents on which they place reliance.

The concerned Superintendent of Police is expected to consider the averments made in the representations and shall instruct the Investigating Officers of these cases to conduct fair and impartial investigation and submit the result of the investigation as expeditiously as possible.
6. Accordingly, the criminal misc. petition as well as stay petition are disposed of.
